name: Mazdak mitomycin C trial
question: Does submucosal mitomycin C injection at internal urethrotomy reduce anterior urethral stricture recurrence compared with urethrotomy without mitomycin C?

arms.label: Internal urethrotomy plus submucosal mitomycin C

design.population: Forty men with anterior urethral strictures underwent direct-vision internal urethrotomy.

verdictNote: Recurrence was lower at six months; the prespecified threshold was not reported.
takeaway: In 40 men with anterior urethral stricture, submucosal mitomycin C injection at internal urethrotomy reduced six-month recurrence versus urethrotomy without mitomycin C (2/20 [10%] versus 10/20 [50%]; p = 0.006).

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Mazdak H, Meshki I, Ghassami F. "Effect of mitomycin C on anterior urethral stricture recurrence after internal urethrotomy." *Eur Urol.* 2007;51(4):1089-1092. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2006.11.038

results.measure: Men with recurrence at six-month assessment
results.note: The abstract calls the difference statistically significant but gives no prespecified alpha or endpoint threshold.

values.exp: Direct-vision internal urethrotomy under general anesthesia, then 0.1 mg mitomycin C injected submucosally at the urethrotomy site
values.ctl: Direct-vision internal urethrotomy under general anesthesia without mitomycin C; control injection not specified in abstract
